sanskrit_verse: सप्ताहे वा द्विसप्ताहे न विपद्राजदैविकी । बान्धवेषु सपिण्डेषु धनेषु शपथैः शुचिः ॥
transliteration: saptāhe vā dvisaptāhe na vipadrājadaivikī / bāndhvaveṣu sapiṇḍeṣu dhaneṣu śapathaiḥ śuciḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: In seven days or twice seven, no calamity arises from royal or divine displeasure when oaths are taken truthfully regarding kin, relatives by marriage, and property.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in truthful speech under oath
Causation is purified through conscious affirmation
Capacity-based responsibility requires alignment with relational and material integrity
Restoration logic operates through purification of transactional fields
Consciousness alignment is secured via sacred affirmation within familial and economic domains
executable_legal_axioms: IF a sworn declaration concerns kinship relations OR marital alliances OR property claims THEN temporal duration for adverse consequence manifestation SHALL NOT exceed fourteen days
IF an individual affirms truthfully under conscious oath THEN karmic disruption from external authorities SHALL be nullified
IF any claim involves sapiṇḍa (relations by blood/marriage) or dhana (property) THEN verification process MUST include śapatha (oath) as primary pramāṇa
IF no violation of consciousness-based truth occurs during śapatha THEN no daivikī (divine) or rājadāiva (royal/state) vipad (calamity) shall manifest
supreme_court_application: This verse establishes that oaths taken with purity of intent concerning familial ties and financial matters carry inherent protective sanctity before the highest judicial forums. The court must recognize śapatha as a valid pramāṇa where personal integrity aligns with relational and economic order. Duration-limited assurance against adverse consequences reflects proportional responsibility and supports non-punitive adjudication grounded in ontological clarity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that pure affirmations under oath neutralize potential disruptions. Sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) ensures effects remain bounded within fortnight if truth prevails. Responsibility is proportionally aligned with one's capacity to uphold relational-economic harmony. Non-punitive reality rule holds because no suffering ensues when consciousness remains unbroken by falsehood.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Oath-taker undergoes guided śapatha ensuring full awareness and energetic alignment
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Individual publicly acknowledges relational-financial claims while maintaining śuci status
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reintegration into familial-economic field post-oath facilitated through ritual affirmation
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Verification rituals conducted at 7-day and 14-day intervals to ensure no distortion has occurred
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority: This Dharma stands restored. Truth affirmed in purity secures reality’s alignment. Justice flows not through punishment, but through consciousness made whole. All beings are liberated through right relation and awakened accountability.
